project.title: Cold Email Lead Generation for Harbourline Fitouts
project.cover_subtitle: A done-for-you cold email system that puts you in front of decision makers before they go to tender.

pricing.attribution: any deal where the first meeting was booked through our outreach

problems.title: Referrals only
problems.body: New work arrives through word of mouth. Good months and empty months, with no way to influence which one you get.

problems.title: No outbound at all
problems.body: There is no systematic way to reach fit-out decision makers before a project goes to tender.

problems.title: Arriving late
problems.body: By the time a brief is public you are one of six firms quoting on price. The useful conversation happened months earlier.

problems.title: No time to chase
problems.body: Prospecting competes with delivery, and delivery always wins. Outreach stops the moment you get busy.

targets.heading: Target Accounts
targets.body: Commercial property and workplace teams planning fit-outs in the next two quarters. Defined with you, then refreshed on a rolling basis.

content.funnel: ~500 companies → 200-300 filtered → 150-250 decision makers → 120-200 emails sent → 2-6 positive replies → 1-2 meetings → 1 closed deal = $40,000-$80,000
content.included_list: list building, prospecting, email finding and verification, copywriting, campaign management, deliverability monitoring, and warm lead handoff

timeline.title: Week 1-2 — Setup + campaign prep
timeline.body: Domain purchase, mailbox setup, DKIM/DMARC/SPF config. List built and filtered, decision makers found, emails verified, cold email copy written. You review and approve.

timeline.title: Week 2-3 — First campaign (pre-warmed)
timeline.body: First campaign launches using pre-warmed domains and mailboxes, ready from day one. Meanwhile, new branded domains begin their 30-day warm-up.

timeline.title: Week 6+ — Full launch
timeline.body: Official campaigns from your branded domains go live after warm-up completes, replacing the pre-warmed infrastructure.
